asr.full_text: Hey there, Aaron here from 3D Sellers. Let's go over how you can use email marketing to save time on customer support and provide excellent service to your buyers. For example, we have a seller that sells radios and electronics for vehicles, and most products that he sells includes a warranty, and many users also need installation instructions. So let's make an automatic message that sends buyers installation instructions and a warranty when they make a purchase. The first thing we'll do is go to messages. Now you can edit a message that you already have, or you can create a new message. We'll make sure that the message sends directly after the item is sold. And I only want this message to send when a car radio sells, so I'll use sending rules and select send message when items have the following rules. Click add rule. I'm going to choose title contains car and radio. And then I want to make sure the title includes both of these terms. So I'll set the operator to and. And then in the message, I will send installation instructions. And I'll paste my link and a link to the car radio's warranty. And then let's make our message friendly and presentable. And now after saving, this message will appear in your list of automatic messages, and each time that a title contains car and the title contains radio, this message will send to the buyer a link to their warranty and a link to their instructions. Thank you very much for watching this quick overview of email marketing and how you can provide excellent customer support and save time providing service to your buyers. Have a great day.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it demonstrates and promotes seller-support software that automatically sends eBay buyers warranty and installation information after qualifying purchases. The described communication concerns business workflow automation and post-purchase customer service, with no investment offer, required viewer payment, credential request, or deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content demonstrates how to configure email-marketing software to send post-purchase buyer-support messages based on item-title rules, making a technology and operational tutorial the central context.
